wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/phpt/run.py: """Runs every extracted php-src case through `php -n` and through elephc, and classifies.

Each case gets its OWN working directory: php's tests litter the cwd with fixtures and several
of them use the same file names, so a shared directory makes one test's leftovers another
test's input.

Verdicts:
  IDENT    both produced the same bytes
  DIFF     both ran, outputs differ
  CRASH    elephc's binary died on a signal (php did not)
  COMPILE  elephc refused to compile the source
  PHPFAIL  `php -n` itself failed/timed out — the case is not a usable oracle
  TIMEOUT  elephc's binary hung
"""
